name: M7.FactorReplay.irreducible_check_exact
statement: ∀ p : M7.FactorReplay.BP, M7.FactorReplay.irreducibleCheck p = true ↔ p.Monic ∧ Irreducible p
context:
theorem M7.FactorReplay.pool_complete : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : M7.FactorReplay.BP), p ∈ M7.FactorReplay.pool n ↔ p.natDegree ≤ n := by
  change ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : M7.FactorReplay.BP), p ∈ M7.FactorReplay.pool n ↔ p.natDegree ≤ n
  intro n p
  classical
  unfold M7.FactorReplay.pool
  rw [Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, _, rfl⟩
    have h := Polynomial.ofFn_natDegree_lt (show 1 ≤ n + 1 by omega) v
    omega
  · intro hp
    refine ⟨Polynomial.toFn (n + 1) p, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    exact Polynomial.ofFn_comp_toFn_eq_id_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)
guidance: Split actual Monic and p=1 guards. In the monic nonone case use Polynomial.Monic.irreducible_iff_lt_natDegree_lt. List.all_eq_true/Finset.mem_toList turns actual finite loop into absence of bounded monic divisors. pool_complete provides every candidate of natDegree≤p.natDegree/2. EuclideanDomain.mod_eq_zero identifies actual remainder=0 with divisibility. No Irreducible decidability oracle occurs in the implementation. Return tactic lines without leading by.
